caption: The drawing depicts a metallic pitcher or tankard with a lid, rendered in shades of gray and blue to suggest a pewter or silver material. The vessel has a geometric, faceted form with three main segments: a wide, hexagonal lower body, a slightly narrower middle section with a horizontal band decorated with repetitions of a relief pattern, and an upper section topped with a domed lid. The lid is adorned with an ornamental finial resembling an animal head and has a curved spout-like protrusion at the top. The handle is angular, joining the body near the top and attaching near the base of the neck, with a decorative element, possibly a flower or rosette, positioned where the handle meets the vessel. The entire image is centered on a plain, off-white background.
title: Pewter Syrup Jug
